title: 2026 UK CBAM compliance and penalty QA controls

sources.title: Carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM): Policy Summary
Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: HMRC states that failure to notify liability for CBAM can attract a penalty.
facts.expected_handling: Track notification compliance separately from emissions calculation.

facts.source_fact: Failure to submit a required CBAM return can attract a penalty.
Failure to pay CBAM can attract a penalty.
facts.expected_handling: Do not confuse payment default with emissions-data error.

facts.source_fact: Errors in CBAM returns or other documents relied upon by HMRC can attract penalties.
Failure to comply with an HMRC information notice can attract a penalty.
HMRC lists failures relating to relevant tax-avoidance disclosures and serial avoidance within the compliance framework.
facts.expected_handling: Keep avoidance compliance distinct from emissions verification.

facts.source_fact: A general penalty is planned for failures to comply with specific CBAM requirements such as required business-detail notifications.
facts.expected_handling: Version the specific administrative requirement involved.

facts.source_fact: The policy includes measures to deter artificial separation of business activities and circumvention of CBAM liability.
facts.expected_handling: Do not split activity artificially to avoid threshold logic.

facts.source_fact: Criminal offences apply for fraudulent evasion and deliberate misstatement of CBAM.
facts.expected_handling: Escalate deliberate falsification separately from ordinary error.

facts.source_fact: HMRC can assess tax due when a person fails to register or provide a complete and accurate return, and can compulsorily register a person who fails to register.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve HMRC assessment and compulsory-registration pathways.

guard_patterns.handling: Separate HMRC assessment from self-reported liability.
Do not treat penalties as emissions measurements.
Flag unresolved obligation, assessment or fraud-status conflicts.
